style: Realistic materials and lighting: tactile natural earth, fine dust, gravel and worn exposed cobbles; rough bark, exposed roots, irregular natural foliage, mossed stone and subtly reflective brown stream water. Physically based materials, low warm late-afternoon sun behind the left shoulder, long cool violet-blue shadows, and natural atmospheric haze. Preserve ivory dust, burnt umber, olive and grey-green hedges, gold ochre stubble and smoke-blue distance. Near and middle distance should look natural and materially convincing, without painterly brush grain, cartoon forms, voxel styling or ASCII effects. Painted scenery is reserved for distant landscape as requested.

rules: Metres, gravity-supported walking with 1.68 m eye height; terrain, road, bridge and drinking ramp use the same canonical support functions as visible surfaces.
Forward is increasing route station. Experiential left is positive lateral offset; the literary compass labels are deliberately not used.
Solid tree trunks, hedgebank and bridge parapets block a 0.28 m walking capsule; shallow water allows wading on the gravel bed, not walking on the water plane.

biomes.macro: Authored mile, hollow, long climb, crest; agricultural country beyond.
biomes.meso: Asymmetric hedge and field, oak rest, stream and three canopy tunnels.
biomes.micro: Ruts, exposed cobbles, root fingers, mown verges, stubble and gorse.

largeForms: Sky occupies over half the arrival view.
Inviting ivory road between olive enclosure on experiential left and golden open field on right.
Hollow delays the long climb; convex crest occludes successive blue painted ranges.
landmarks: One great oak at 110 m; one bridge 91.44 m farther.
Leaning milestone at 730 m; crest at 1240 m.
Distant village behind at -1050 m, smoky ridge ahead.
relationships: No repeated landmark chunks; landmark membership uses unique authored coordinates.
Bridge deck and road ramp share support; 4.572 m water-span.
The grove passages are 42 m long and alternate cool enclosure with open glare.
detail: Fine scanned earth/grass/bark/moss surfaces and alpha-tested leafy sprigs, crooked organic timber, irregular feathered verge and bank scatter. Painted simplification is reserved for distant overlapping hills and the bare crown.

Stable tree bases retained; independent seeded multilevel Bezier limbs, joined radius taper and thin twigs replace radial wheel spokes. Three worn angular paving variants replace identical oval cobbles.
atmosphere: Low warm sun behind left, cool elongated shadows, animated dust, ditch midges, brown flowing stream and rising village smoke.

navigation.action: WASD/arrows or touch; Shift for brisk walking
navigation.effect: Move grounded capsule along shared canonical surfaces

camera.action: Drag the scene or use accessible turn buttons
camera.effect: Yaw and pitch the actual camera

defaults: Technical seed worldweaver-default-1 and generationVersion 1; worldId is style-independent contract hash.
Exploration only: no edits, resources, inventory or populated horses. Synthesized wind/leaves/stream sound is off until an explicit Sound on gesture, then softened under canopy.
Three/WebGL2 base profile; 90 FPS remains a target, not a measurement.
Existing experiential GREEN LEFT / GOLD RIGHT framing is retained; compass clarification remains pending with the controller. No claim of C02 resolution is made.
Authorized presentation correction: more realistic materials and lighting; retain route, coordinates, seed, identity and composition from the initial plan.

Controller-admitted CC0 1k scans and HDR add approximately 56 MiB decoded/mipmapped shared GPU assets. CPU/GPU ceilings provisioned at 192 MiB within contract; this is reservation planning, not measured consumption or a changed performance target.

referenceObservations.observed: Nine admitted regular CC0 files matched supplied SHA-256 values. HDRLoader decoded Dry Field as 1024x512 linear radiance; metadata and brightest pixel recorded in evidence/hdr-inspection.json. The controller reported visual defects in the preliminary bundle.
referenceObservations.interpretation: Use grass/earth/bark/rock scans for materially distinct surfaces; generic willow bark is not an oak-species claim. Use HDR for PBR environment lighting while retaining the composed sky.
referenceObservations.uncertainty: Final corrected pixels, hardware memory and sustained performance require controller recapture/review.

repairs.reason: Independent release review; terrain residual envelope, keyboard escape, global atmosphere, truthful readiness, consented sound, tree/pavement detail. C02 clarification and C07 native resource evidence remain controller-owned.
